Discover and ingest an fMRIPrep or postprocessed participant into a unified MEDuSA time-series bundle

Source: R/fmriprep_bids.R
read_fmriprep_subject.Rd

Locates a participant's preprocessed or BrainGnomes-postprocessed BOLD runs (*_desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz or *_desc-<desc>_bold.nii.gz), brain or template masks (*_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz, *_templatemask.nii.gz), confound tables (*_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv, *_desc-<desc>_confounds.tsv), optional fMRIPost-AROMA / legacy ICA-AROMA mixing and classification sidecars, optional *_censor.1D masks, and optional BIDS event tables (*_events.tsv), returning a "medusa_nifti_ts" object populated with C++-extracted T x V $bold matrices, $voxel_map, $parcel_ids, $tr, $nuisance, $valid_rows, $confounds, and $events in locked run order, ready to pass directly into estimate_crossrun_hrf and deconvolve_crossrun_hrf.

Usage

read_fmriprep_subject(
  fmriprep_dir,
  sub,
  bids_dir = NULL,
  ses = NULL,
  task = NULL,
  runs = NULL,
  space = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  desc = "preproc",
  mask = "auto",
  mask_mode = c("intersection", "union", "first"),
  atlas = NULL,
  atlas_subset = NULL,
  mask_threshold = 0,
  atlas_threshold = 0,
  tr = NULL,
  events = "auto",
  condition_col = "trial_type",
  condition_map = NULL,
  default_condition = NULL,
  exclude_conditions = NULL,
  na_duration = 0,
  aroma = "none",
  aroma_dir = NULL,
  aroma_clean_nuisance = TRUE,
  aroma_fit_valid = FALSE,
  strategy = c("24p", "6p", "12p", "csf_wm", "csf_wm_8p", "24p_csf_wm", "27p", "36p",
    "compcor", "custom", "none"),
  columns = NULL,
  column_pattern = NULL,
  n_compcor = NULL,
  compcor_type = c("anatomical", "split", "temporal"),
  include_cosines = "auto",
  censor = "auto",
  fd_threshold = 0.5,
  fd_col = "auto",
  head_radius = 50,
  rot_units = c("rad", "deg"),
  motion_bandstop_bpm = NULL,
  motion_lowpass_hz = NULL,
  motion_filter_order = NULL,
  motion_filter_pad = c("constant", "odd", "even", "zero"),
  motion_filter_target = c("fd_only", "fd_and_nuisance"),
  dvars_threshold = NULL,
  dvars_col = "std_dvars",
  include_non_steady_state = TRUE,
  include_motion_outliers = FALSE,
  drop_initial_volumes = 0L,
  censor_prev = 0L,
  censor_next = 0L,
  min_segment_length = 1L,
  id_style = c("ijk", "vnum"),
  ncpus = 1L
)

Arguments

fmriprep_dir

Path to the fMRIPrep or BrainGnomes postprocessing derivatives root directory (or directly to sub-<id>).

sub

Participant identifier (with or without "sub-" prefix, e.g., "01" or "sub-01").

bids_dir

Optional path to the raw BIDS root directory containing *_events.tsv files (when events = "auto").

ses

Optional session filter (with or without "ses-" prefix).

task

Optional BIDS task label (with or without "task-" prefix). Required when multiple tasks exist for the participant.

runs

Optional vector of run identifiers to include (e.g., 1:3 or c("01", "02")).

space

Optional template/output space filter (e.g., "MNI152NLin2009cAsym"). Auto-selected when only one space is present; required when multiple spaces exist.

cohort

Optional TemplateFlow cohort-* entity filter (e.g., "1" or "2" for MNIPediatricAsym). Auto-selected when unique; required when multiple cohorts exist.

res

Optional BIDS resolution entity (res-*). Auto-selected when unique.

desc

BOLD derivative desc-* entity (default "preproc" for fMRIPrep; use e.g. "postproc" for BrainGnomes postprocessed outputs, or NULL to match un-described BOLD files).

mask

Either "auto" (default; discovers per-run *_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz or *_templatemask.nii.gz files and combines them via mask_mode, falling back to anatomical mask, provenance spatial mask, or atlas), an explicit 3D NIfTI path / RNifti image, or NULL.

mask_mode

Rule for combining per-run brain masks when mask = "auto": "intersection" (default; retains voxels in-mask across every run), "union", or "first".

atlas

Optional 3D parcellation NIfTI path or RNifti image on the BOLD spatial grid.

atlas_subset

Optional integer/numeric vector of parcel labels to retain.

mask_threshold

Numeric threshold (>) applied to mask. Default 0.

atlas_threshold

Numeric threshold (>) applied to atlas. Default 0.

tr

Optional repetition time in seconds (inferred from NIfTI headers or *_bold.json RepetitionTime when NULL).

events

Either "auto" (default; discovers matching *_events.tsv in bids_dir / fmriprep_dir), explicit event file paths / data.frames passed to read_bids_events, or NULL to skip event ingestion (e.g., resting-state).

condition_col, condition_map, default_condition, exclude_conditions, na_duration

Event normalization options forwarded to read_bids_events.

aroma

ICA-AROMA denoising policy applied in memory during ingestion:

  • "none" (default): no AROMA projection applied.

  • "nonaggressive": discovers fMRIPost-AROMA (*_desc-melodic_mixing.tsv + *_desc-aroma_metrics.tsv) or legacy fMRIPrep <= 23.0 (*_desc-MELODIC_mixing.tsv + *_AROMAnoiseICs.csv) sidecars and applies Pruim et al. (2015) non-aggressive partial regression to $bold (and selected $nuisance columns when aroma_clean_nuisance = TRUE).

  • "auto": applies "nonaggressive" AROMA when matching AROMA sidecars exist for all runs and skips silently otherwise.

  • "aggressive": applies full orthogonal removal of rejected AROMA components without protecting accepted signal components.

  • A pre-constructed "medusa_aroma" object from read_fmriprep_aroma (applied non-aggressively).

When BrainGnomes provenance indicates apply_aroma was already executed upstream on the BOLD derivative, duplicate AROMA regression on $bold is skipped automatically.

aroma_dir

Optional path to an fMRIPost-AROMA derivatives root (or subject directory). When NULL, read_fmriprep_subject() searches fmriprep_dir, BrainGnomes provenance SourceFiles, and sibling fmripost_aroma / fmripost-aroma / aroma derivative directories automatically.

aroma_clean_nuisance

Logical; if TRUE (default), applies the identical AROMA projection operator to selected $nuisance columns so downstream joint regression in estimate_crossrun_hrf and deconvolve_crossrun_hrf cannot re-introduce removed AROMA motion variance (Lindquist et al., 2019).

aroma_fit_valid

Logical; if TRUE, estimates AROMA component weights using uncensored valid_rows only rather than full MELODIC timecourses (FALSE, default).

strategy, columns, column_pattern, n_compcor, compcor_type, include_cosines

Nuisance selection options forwarded to read_fmriprep_confounds (including "csf_wm" and "csf_wm_8p" for pairing physiological regressors with aroma = "nonaggressive"). When BrainGnomes provenance indicates confound_regression was already applied to the BOLD derivative and strategy is not explicitly specified, strategy defaults automatically to "none" to avoid double-regressing unfiltered confounds.

censor

Either "auto" (default; automatically uses matching *_censor.1D sidecars when present for postprocessed outputs), explicit censor file paths / vectors forwarded to read_fmriprep_confounds, or NULL to ignore *_censor.1D sidecars.

fd_threshold, fd_col, head_radius, rot_units, motion_bandstop_bpm, motion_lowpass_hz, motion_filter_order, motion_filter_pad, motion_filter_target, dvars_threshold, dvars_col, include_non_steady_state, include_motion_outliers, drop_initial_volumes, censor_prev, censor_next, min_segment_length

Clock-preserving censoring and optional respiratory motion filtering options forwarded to read_fmriprep_confounds.

id_style

Voxel ID convention forwarded to read_nifti_ts ("ijk" or "vnum").

ncpus

Number of parallel workers forwarded to read_nifti_ts.

Value

An S3 object of class "medusa_nifti_ts" enriched with $nuisance, $valid_rows, $confounds ("medusa_confounds"), $aroma (when AROMA is applied), $events (when discovered/supplied), and $bids provenance metadata.

See also

read_nifti_ts, read_fmriprep_confounds, read_fmriprep_aroma, apply_aroma, read_bids_events, estimate_crossrun_hrf, deconvolve_crossrun_hrf

Examples

root <- tempfile("medusa_bids_demo_")
fprep_func <- file.path(root, "derivatives", "fmriprep", "sub-01", "func")
bids_func <- file.path(root, "bids", "sub-01", "func")
dir.create(fprep_func, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(bids_func, recursive = TRUE)

mask_img <- RNifti::asNifti(array(1L, dim = c(2L, 2L, 2L)))
RNifti::pixdim(mask_img) <- c(2, 2, 2)
for (r in 1:2) {
  stem <- sprintf("sub-01_task-mid_run-0%d", r)
  bold_arr <- array(rnorm(2L * 2L * 2L * 10L), dim = c(2L, 2L, 2L, 10L))
  bold_img <- RNifti::asNifti(bold_arr)
  RNifti::pixdim(bold_img) <- c(2, 2, 2, 1.0)
  RNifti::writeNifti(
    bold_img,
    file.path(fprep_func, paste0(stem, "_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz"))
  )
  RNifti::writeNifti(
    mask_img,
    file.path(fprep_func, paste0(stem, "_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz"))
  )
  conf_df <- data.frame(
    trans_x = rnorm(10, sd = 0.02), trans_y = rnorm(10, sd = 0.02),
    trans_z = rnorm(10, sd = 0.02), rot_x = rnorm(10, sd = 0.002),
    rot_y = rnorm(10, sd = 0.002), rot_z = rnorm(10, sd = 0.002),
    framewise_displacement = c("n/a", rep("0.08", 9))
  )
  utils::write.table(
    conf_df,
    file.path(fprep_func, paste0(stem, "_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv")),
    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
  )
  ev_df <- data.frame(onset = c(2, 6), duration = c(0.5, 0.5), trial_type = c("cue", "feedback"))
  utils::write.table(
    ev_df,
    file.path(bids_func, paste0(stem, "_events.tsv")),
    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
  )
}

sub01 <- read_fmriprep_subject(
  fmriprep_dir = file.path(root, "derivatives", "fmriprep"),
  bids_dir = file.path(root, "bids"),
  sub = "01",
  task = "mid",
  strategy = "6p"
)
sub01
#> <medusa_nifti_ts> 2 runs | 8 voxels | spatial dim: 2x2x2 | TR: 1 s | orientation: time_by_voxel
#>   Confounds attached: 0/20 volume(s) censored | nuisance: 6 col(s)
#>   BIDS events attached: 4 event row(s) ($events available)
#>   - run1: 10 volumes (sub-01_task-mid_run-01_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz)
#>   - run2: 10 volumes (sub-01_task-mid_run-02_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz)
unlink(root, recursive = TRUE)
